Structural Constraints

Why Most Ad Budgets Bleed Efficiency

Paid traffic fails when campaigns lack negative keyword sculpting, conversion feed accuracy, or creative separation. We solve the core mechanical faults that inflate acquisition costs.

Broad Match & Negative Leaks

Google smart-bidding algorithms burn budget on low-intent, non-commercial search queries when campaigns lack strict negative keyword architecture and match-type isolation.

PMax Black-Box Cannibalization

Unsegmented Performance Max campaigns claim easy conversions from existing branded searches, masking the reality that net-new customer prospecting is failing.

Meta Creative Saturation

Relying on one or two ad creatives quickly leads to audience fatigue and rising CPMs. Without a systematic testing framework, scaling ad spend simply drives higher costs.

Conflicting Platform Attribution

Both Google Ads and Meta report the exact same conversion, leading founders to overestimate campaign impact. We align tracking to reality through verified measurement.

Landing Page Disconnect

Sending paid traffic to generic homepages or slow, cluttered pages tanks conversion rates. Paid traffic demands strict message match, high mobile speed, and focused inquiry paths.

The Groniq Approach

Granular structure, disciplined negative list updates, verified conversion signals, and continuous hypothesis-driven creative testing designed to protect margins.

Tailored Strategies

Built for Service Businesses & E-Commerce Brands

Lead generation and direct-to-consumer e-commerce operate on fundamentally different mechanics. We tailor campaigns specifically to the target market in the United States and Dubai.

Lead Generation & Services

Qualified Inquiries, Calls & Bookings

For service operators, contractors, medical clinics, and B2B consultancies in regional US markets or Dubai, ad dollars must drive verified commercial inquiries, phone inquiries, and confirmed appointments.

Commercial Intent Keyword Mapping

Targeting exact problems ("emergency HVAC repair Miami", "corporate legal audit Dubai") while excluding informational search queries.

Tight Geo-Radius & Scheduling

Limiting spend strictly to serviceable zip codes, districts, and business operating hours so incoming calls are answered immediately.

Frictionless Mobile Inquiry Flows

Fast mobile landing pages with tap-to-call, WhatsApp click triggers (essential for UAE prospects), and qualified multi-step quote forms.

E-Commerce & DTC

Purchases, Revenue & Margin Protection

For Shopify and DTC consumer brands competing in competitive US and GCC e-commerce sectors, success requires managing blended acquisition costs, protecting contribution margins, and scaling winning SKUs.

Google Shopping & Product Feed Optimization

Custom label segmentation (high margin, bestsellers, seasonal) and enriched titles with brand, size, and material attributes.

Performance Max Asset Group Isolation

Segmenting PMax by product line with strict brand exclusions to prevent budget waste on brand-name keywords.

Meta Creative Iteration & Retargeting

Testing hooks, product demonstrations, and social proof angles for cold acquisition, combined with dynamic product ads for warm consideration.

Scope of Work

Services & Concrete Deliverables

Every engagement is executed with disciplined account hygiene, clear deliverables, and transparent communication.

Primary Focus

Google Ads Architecture

Capitalizing on existing intent when customers are actively searching for solutions.

  • Commercial Search Campaigns: Single-intent ad group structuring, responsive search ads (RSAs), and pin testing.
  • Continuous Negative Keyword Sculpting: Bi-weekly search term mining to block irrelevant search waste.
  • Google Shopping Feed Optimization: Merchant Center error resolution, custom feed labels, and title keyword enrichment.
  • Performance Max Architecture: Segmented asset groups, first-party audience signals, and brand exclusion lists.
  • Smart Bidding Calibration: Transitioning from Maximize Clicks to target CPA or target ROAS once sufficient conversion volume is verified.

Meta Ads Architecture

Generating demand through visual storytelling, angle testing, and algorithmic audience expansion.

  • Audience Planning: Broad prospecting with Advantage+, high-value customer lookalikes, and interest clustering.
  • Creative Testing Framework: Systematic rotation of visual hooks, headlines, and formats (static, carousel, UGC video).
  • Full-Funnel Campaign Structure: Separating top-of-funnel discovery from mid-funnel consideration and dynamic catalog retargeting.
  • Budget Consolidation: Avoiding audience fragmentation and ad-set overlap to keep Meta's machine learning stable.

Landing Page & Conversion Review

Ensuring the destination page is engineered to convert the traffic you pay for.

  • Message Match Audit: Aligning ad promises directly with above-the-fold headline and value proposition.
  • Mobile Friction Analysis: Auditing page load latency, form field count, and checkout barriers.
  • Conversion Tracking Readiness: Pre-launch verification that conversion triggers fire accurately before launching campaigns. (See our Measurement & Tracking service).

Account Audit & Management

Ongoing data-driven management to protect ad spend and seize new opportunities.

  • Comprehensive Baseline Audit: Identifying historical waste, duplicate keywords, bid cannibalization, and tracking bugs.
  • Weekly Bid & Budget Optimization: Shifting capital dynamically toward profitable segments, search queries, and placements.
  • Transparent Reporting: Clear bi-weekly summaries focused on commercial metrics: spend, cost per inquiry/sale, and ROAS.

Methodology

The Working Process

A systematic five-phase engineering lifecycle designed to eliminate guesswork and validate performance at each stage.

01 / REVIEW

Audit & Baseline

Review historical ad data, search query reports, landing page conversion readiness, and customer unit economics.

02 / PLAN

Strategy & Structure

Define keyword intent tiers, negative lists, target CPA/ROAS thresholds, budget splits, and creative testing roadmaps.

03 / BUILD

Build & QA

Build clean campaign hierarchies, ad copy, extensions, audience signals, and verify conversion tracking endpoints.

04 / LAUNCH

Controlled Launch

Deploy campaigns under conservative budget pacing, monitor initial search terms daily, and ensure data flows cleanly.

05 / OPTIMIZE

Iterate & Scale

Harvest high-converting queries, eliminate underperforming keywords, iterate creative angles, and scale profitable segments.

Clear Boundaries

Engagement Scope & Client Requirements

We believe in transparent scopes with zero ambiguity around billing, responsibility, and project dependencies.

Billing & Project Scope Clarifications

  • Advertising Spend Is Separate: Media ad spend is paid directly to advertising networks (Google Ads, Meta Ads) using the client's own corporate card or invoice profile. Groniq never marks up ad spend or handles media payments.
  • Separate Technical Scope: Advanced tracking implementations (server-side GTM, Conversions API), dedicated landing page web development, net-new video/graphic creative production, and substantial product-feed re-architectures are scoped as distinct projects according to technical requirements.
  • No Artificial Guarantees: We do not make false guarantees of specific revenue numbers or ranking positions. We guarantee disciplined execution, verified data, and rigorous optimization.

What We Require from Clients

  • Administrative Account Access: Standard manager access to your Google Ads, Google Merchant Center, Meta Business Manager, and analytics properties.
  • Unit Economics & Margin Clarity: Realistic benchmarks for allowable Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC), average order value (AOV), and customer lifetime value (LTV).
  • Timely Approvals & Lead Handling: Prompt feedback on copy/creative reviews, and an operational team that calls or processes incoming inquiries promptly.
Frequently Asked Questions

Common Questions on Paid Campaigns

How is ad spend paid?

You pay advertising networks directly. Your credit card or billing profile is linked directly inside your Google Ads and Meta accounts. Groniq charges a separate, transparent service management fee.

How long before campaigns start generating results?

Google Search campaigns targeting commercial intent can generate qualified clicks within 24 to 48 hours of launch. However, algorithmic bid strategies (target CPA, target ROAS) require 2 to 4 weeks of consistent conversion data to calibrate and reach peak efficiency.

Should we invest in Google Ads or Meta Ads first?

If there is active commercial search demand for your product or service, Google Ads is almost always the right starting point because it captures users already seeking a solution. If you are launching an innovative consumer product with low search volume, Meta Ads is typically prioritized to generate awareness and visual demand.

How do you manage campaigns across the United States vs. Dubai (UAE)?

We tailor campaigns strictly to regional search behavior and audience preferences. In Dubai, WhatsApp click triggers and rapid mobile responses are critical conversion pathways alongside English/Arabic localization. In the US, automated appointment scheduling, detailed landing page reviews, and strict zip-code radius targeting take center stage.

What if our landing page doesn't convert?

We review landing pages prior to launching traffic. If minor message tweaks or layout adjustments are needed, we provide actionable guidance. If a complete conversion landing page build is required, we scope that as a dedicated web deliverable.
